title: Ricardo Gill — Neuroscience and brain computer interfaces
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Plausible application proposal; full original EBR-N manuscript unavailable

finder_profile.audience: Neuroscience and brain computer interfaces researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Use EBR-style provenance to track consented recordings, preprocessing, decoder versions and later reanalysis. Evaluate whether preserved transformation paths improve interpretation recovery during decoder drift.
illustrative_example: Decoder A interprets a preserved recording differently from decoder B months later. Retain both outputs with their versions instead of rewriting the original interpretation.
evaluation_targets: Decoder-version reconstruction, held-out decoding error, drift detection, uncertainty and recovery after recalibration.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
